text: Slice 7 starts as D-0045's Part B planned. An issue on gitdek/invariant, written from the watcher's code, describes the factory's issue protocol completely. It names `Project: factory/protocol` and asks for a model of one issue that's finite without counting events. Overnight, under @gitdek's permission to act for him, the agent answers only questions the code or a ratified decision already settles. It ratifies only a proposal that restates decisions @gitdek already ratified, says so on the issue, and leaves anything new for him. Wiring the watcher to the proved core touches the trusted base, so it lands by pull request for @gitdek to merge (D-0048).
